data.reason_zh: 单次蒸馏迁移教师能力到小模型，harness 固定，无多轮自改进闭环。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: When such an agent is distilled into a smaller one, the harness stays in place
scope_support.object_quote: We propose Harness-Aware Distillation (HAD), which focuses distillation on what the teacher adds beyond the harness.
